questions.explanation: We can solve the system of equations by multiplying the second equation by 2 and adding it to the first equation to eliminate y: 2x + 5y + 2x - 4y = 17 - 6, 4x + y = 11. Then, we can multiply the second equation by 5 and add it to the first equation to eliminate y: 2x + 5y + 5x - 10y = 17 + 15, 7x - 5y = 32.
